# Aaron Amerling

Marketing and product leader based in San Diego, California. Chief Marketing
Officer most recently at Etna Interactive, where he led a 60-person marketing
organization. Co-inventor on five U.S. patents for a trust-network architecture.
Early marketing advisor to GoFundMe.

Available for full-time marketing leadership roles (CMO at early stage, VP at
mid-market, Director at enterprise) and for a small number of fractional and
advisory engagements.

Specializes in: growth marketing, answer engine optimization (AEO), generative
engine optimization (GEO), applied AI inside marketing organizations,
go-to-market strategy, demand generation, product marketing, and marketing
organization design.
